text: Psychology is a science that studies human psychological phenomena, behaviors and their laws, integrating perspectives from multiple disciplines such as biology, sociology and philosophy. The training objective is: Through systematic study of psychological science theories and research methods, students will be equipped with the ability to analyze psychological phenomena, design experiments, interpret data and apply intervention, and be capable of engaging in psychological assessment, counseling and treatment, talent management or academic research in fields such as education, clinical practice, enterprises and scientific research.
